ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels, with white primarily restricted to the trailing edges and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pigment concentrated along the trailing margins and outer tips. Small, discrete white focal spots and irregular mottling are distributed across the primary dark-pigmented central surfaces of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 50-degree internal angle and significant depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and irregular amplitude serrations along the continuous trailing edge, characterized by jagged peaks and varying depths of valleys across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning into sharp, pointed distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density distribution of circular and annular high-contrast white scars (rosettes) across the dark ventral surface, particularly concentrated in the lower central regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct linear pixel disruptions visible, including a prominent horizontal scratch on the middle left lobe and multiple diagonal rake-like marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active barnacle colonization visible as high-contrast clusters on the extreme distal edges of both lobes; extensive ring-shaped scarring across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of circular ring-shaped scars, likely from previous parasitic attachments or barnacle colonization, covering the majority of the dark-pigmented area.
